size.description: Frame size preset or `[w, h]`. Default `"16:9"` (1920×1080).

background.description: Default background of every scene (colour or gradient). Default `"$bg"`.

theme.description: Colour tokens, fonts and text styles.

defs.description: Reusable scenes and layers, referenced with `{ "use": "name", "with": {…}, …overrides }`.

transition.description: Default transition between scenes. Default crossfade 0.5 s.

markers.description: Named times on the global timeline, referenced as `"@name"`.

music.description:
Generated, mastered music (`anikit-video docs music`): `{"style":"lofi","bpm":84,"key":"Dm","hits":["@bar5"]}`.
Fills the video's length; `@beatN`/`@barN` markers follow its exact grid.

fonts.description: Extra fonts: family name → file path.

duration.description: Override the total duration (truncate, or hold the last frame).

post.description:
Finishing look: a preset (`none clean cinematic dreamy punchy noir vintage`) or
`{ "preset": "cinematic", "bloom": 0.4, … }`. Default none.

cut.description:
Default scene length: `"bar"`, `"2 beats"`, `"4 bars"` (at the music's tempo) or seconds.
Scenes without a `duration` cut on that grid.

encode.description: Encoder tuning (the built-in ak264 MP4 encoder): `{ "aq": 0.8 }`.

motionBlur.description:
Motion blur on moving content: `true` (180° shutter), `false`, or `{ "shutter": 90 }` (degrees).
Default: on at `--quality high` only (it renders several sub-frames per moving frame).

compositions.description: Named 2D sub-compositions: placed with a `composition` layer, or used as a texture in 3D.

Paint.description:
A colour or gradient: a CSS string (`"#fff"`, `"$primary"`,
`"linear-gradient(90deg, #f00, #00f)"`) or a gradient object.

angle.description: Linear angle in degrees (CSS convention: 180 = top to bottom). Default 180.

stops.description: Colours, evenly spaced, or `[offset, colour]` pairs.

center.description: Radial centre `[x, y]` as fractions of the box. Default `[0.5, 0.5]`.

radius.description: Radial radius as a fraction of the box diagonal / 2. Default 1.

Theme.description: Theme: colour tokens (`"$name"`), font roles and text styles.

material.description: Material defaults every component takes unless its props say otherwise.

Num.description:
A number, a unit string (`"50%"`, `"10vh"`, `"1.5s"`, `"12f"`, `"@marker+0.2"`),
a relative value (`"+40"`, `"*1.5"`) or an expression (`"=sin(t)*10"`).

Material.description: Art-direction defaults for components (a look's finish). Explicit component props win.

SceneItem.description: Schema helper: a scene or a string (a title card).

notes.description:
Free text for the author (ignored by the renderer): what this shot
shows and why, e.g. the reference shot it recreates (`analyze --spec`).

use.description:
Reuse: the name of an entry in top-level `defs`; other keys here override it
(expanded before typing, see `spec/reuse.rs`).

with.description: Values for `"$param"` placeholders in the `use`d def.

repeat.description:
Emit this many copies; `"$i"` (0-based) and `"$n"` are available, and
`"=…"` strings are arithmetic (`"x": "=160 + $i * 420"`).

duration.description: Seconds (or a time string), or `"auto"`. Default 3.

transition.description: How this scene comes in from the previous one.

post.description: Finishing look for this scene (overrides the video's `post`; `"none"` turns it off).

markers.description: Times relative to the scene start.

stack.description:
Lay out the scene's free-floating layers (no `x`/`y`) as one centred column:
`true`, a gap in px, or `{ "gap": 24, "align": "start|center|end" }`. Expanded at load.

audio.description: Audio cues relative to the scene start.

type.description: `cut`, `crossfade`, `fadeBlack`, `fadeWhite`, `slide`, `push`, `zoom`, `wipe`, `iris`, `blur`, `glitch`, `morphCut`. One of: cut, crossfade, fade, fadeBlack, fadeWhite, slide, push, zoom, wipe, iris, blur, glitch, morphCut, shader.

direction.description: `left`, `right`, `up`, `down`. One of: left, right, up, down.

shader.description:
`type: "shader"`: a gl-transitions style shader (`vec4 transition(vec2 uv)` with
`progress`, `getFromColor`, `getToColor`) or a built-in transition name.

focus.description: Depth in focus (layers at this `depth` are sharp). Default 0. Animatable (focus pulls).

aperture.description: Depth-of-field strength: blur σ in px per unit of |depth − focus|. Default 0 (off).

AnimateItem.description: Schema helper: `animate` as a preset name, one tween or a list.

at.description: Start, relative to the layer's start. `"+0.2"` = after the previous tween.

from.description: Animate from these values to the layer's own.

preset.description: A preset run as a tween at `at`.

SpringSpec.description: Spring: a preset name or parameters.

PostValue.description: `post`: a preset name or a preset with overrides.

anyOf.description: `none clean cinematic dreamy punchy noir vintage`.

LayerItem.description: Schema helper: a layer or a string (text).

Layer.description:
A layer. One flat type for every kind; `type` picks the kind (and is
inferred when obvious). Keys that don't apply to the kind are warned about.

type.description: `text`, `shape`, `image`, `video`, `group`, `box`, `component`. Inferred when omitted. One of: text, shape, image, video, group, box, component, composition, shader, draw, dots.

use.description:
Reuse: the name of an entry in top-level `defs`; other keys here override it
(expanded before typing, see `spec/reuse.rs`).

with.description: Values for `"$param"` placeholders in the `use`d def.

repeat.description:
A number: emit this many copies at spec level (`"$i"`, `"$n"`, `"=…"` arithmetic).
An object: a render-time repeater (`{"count": 12, "offset": {"rotate": 30}, "stagger": 0.05}`).

echo.description: Motion trails: draw earlier-time copies under the layer, `{"count": 6, "delay": 0.04, "decay": 0.6}`.

path.description:
Follow a motion path (SVG path data in parent pixels): `x`/`y` come from the path at `progress`
(0..1, animatable; default: linear over the layer's life).

orient.description: With `path`: rotate the layer along the path's tangent (`true`, or an extra angle in degrees).

textPath.description: Text on a path: SVG path data (layer-local pixels); glyphs ride it, shifted by `pathOffset` px (animatable).

pathOffset.description: Text on a path: shift along the path in px (animatable as `pathOffset`).

dashOffset.description: Stroke dash offset in px, added to `stroke.dashOffset` (animatable as `dashOffset`; `"=t*-120"` marches ants).

roundCorners.description: Shape modifier: round every corner of the outline by this radius (px).

zigzag.description: Shape modifier: zigzag the outline, `{"size": 12, "ridges": 20, "smooth": false}`.

puckerBloat.description: Shape modifier: pucker (< 0) or bloat (> 0) the outline, −1..1.

offsetPath.description: Shape modifier: grow (> 0) or shrink (< 0) the outline by this many px.

twist.description: Shape modifier: twist the outline around its centre by this many degrees (more at the rim).

wigglePath.description: Shape modifier: noise-displace the outline's vertices, `{"amount": 10, "detail": 24, "speed": 1, "seed": 1}` (animated, deterministic).

matte.description: Track matte: another layer of the scene (by `id`) whose alpha or luma shows this one.

blend.description: One of: normal, add, multiply, screen, overlay, darken, lighten, softLight, difference.

depth.description:
Distance from the focal plane (0 = the plane, positive = farther, negative = nearer).
Farther layers move less when the camera pans (parallax) and blur with the camera's `aperture`.

clip.description: `true` clips children to the layer box, or a clip shape.

mask.description: A layer whose alpha masks this one.

loop.description:
Repeating motion: `float`, `pulse`, `spin`, `wiggle`, `breathe`, `blink`
(for `video` layers, a bool: loop the clip).

stagger.description: Delay children's animations by index × seconds (group, box, split text).

align.description: One of: left, center, right, justify.

kinetic.description: Kinetic text animation (TEXT module): shorthand like `"pop by char from center 0.4s 30ms outBack"`, or an object.

shape.description: `rect`, `circle`, `ellipse`, `line`, `arrow`, `polygon`, `star`, `path`. One of: rect, circle, ellipse, line, arrow, polygon, star, path.

fit.description:
Images: `contain`, `cover`, `fill`, `none`. Text: `true` shrinks the
size (never grows it) so the widest line fits `width` (default 85% of
the parent), keeping line breaks. One of: contain, cover, fill, none.

update.description:
Per-frame script: returns props to set this frame, e.g. `"#{ x: 960 + 200 * sin(t), fill: hsl(t * 90, 80, 60) }"`.
Sees `t T gt p i n w h fps frame beat bar level bpm`. Runs every frame (a few µs).

dots.description:
Data points drawn as dots in frame pixels (thousands are fine: one path per colour):
`{ "data": [[x, y], …] | "points.csv", "size": 4, "color": "$accent", "appear": "=t * 800 - i" }`.

draw.description:
Raw drawing: primitives in frame pixels (the layer defaults to the parent's box), each
with its own fill and stroke. The layer's transforms, opacity, animation and `trimStart`/`trimEnd` apply.

composition.description: Name of an entry in top-level `compositions`.

component.description: Component kind. One of: code, terminal, bar-chart, line-chart, area-chart, donut-chart, pie-chart, counter, stat, phone, laptop, browser, card, button, toggle, badge, avatar, avatar-stack, progress-bar, progress-ring, toast, cursor, tooltip, callout, arrow, lower-third, title-card, mesh-gradient, aurora, grain, grid, dots, light-leak, bokeh, starfield, gradient, confetti, sparks, snow, dust, particle-text, morph, metaballs, god-rays, lens-flare, model, scene-3d, text-3d, globe, wipe, iris, glitch, chat, prompt, checklist, quote, table, timeline, marquee, spotlight, keys, visualizer, ken-burns, tile-reveal, kinetic-grid, reactions, card-stack, product-shot, now-playing, lottie.

uniforms.description: Shader uniforms by name: a number, `[x, y(, z, w)]`, a colour or an `"=expr"`. Animatable by name in `animate`.

channels.description:
Shader inputs `iChannel0..3`: `"below"`, `"noise"`, an image/video path, `{ "layers": [...] }`,
optionally with `"wrap": "repeat"|"mirror"`, `"filter": "nearest"`, `"mipmaps": true`.

filter.description: Shader as a filter: `iChannel0` is everything drawn below, and the output replaces the frame.

supersample.description:
Shader: anti-aliasing (adaptive 2×2 where neighbours differ). Default on for shader layers
unless the source says `// anikit:aa off`; off for filters. `false` is up to 2× faster.

alpha.description: Shader: use `fragColor.a` as alpha (default: opaque, like Shadertoy).

buffers.description:
Shader: Shadertoy-style buffer passes `"A"`…`"D"`, rendered in order before the image
pass at full float precision. A channel `"A"` reads buffer A: this frame's if A ran
earlier in the order, else the previous frame's (feedback, for simulations).

RepeatValue.description: `repeat` on a layer: a spec-level copy count, or a render-time repeater.

RepeaterSpec.description: Render-time repeater (After Effects style): `count` copies, each offset from the last.

count.description: Number of copies (including the original). Default 3.

offset.description:
Per-copy change: `x`, `y` (px), `rotate` (deg), `scale` (multiplier, number or `[sx, sy]`),
`opacity` (added per copy, e.g. −0.1), `hue` (degrees per copy).

stagger.description: Seconds of delay per copy (copy i plays i × stagger later).

center.description: Rotation/scale centre `[x, y]` in parent pixels (default: the layer's own position).

EchoSpec.description: `echo`: earlier-time copies drawn under the layer.

blend.description: Blend mode of the echoes (`normal`, `add`, `screen`, …). Default normal.

ridges.description: Ridges per segment (per closed outline for ellipses). Default 10.

smooth.description: Smooth waves instead of sharp corners.

detail.description: Points the outline is resampled to. Default 32.

speed.description: Noise cycles per second (0 = frozen). Default 1.

layer.description: `id` of the matte layer (in the same scene; it is not drawn itself).

Anchor.description: Anchor: `[ax, ay]` in 0..1 or a name (`center`, `topLeft`, …).

Clip.description: `clip`: `true` (the layer box) or a shape layer.

distance.description: Move distance (px or unit string) for move presets.

total.description: Spread the delays over this many seconds instead.

from.description: `start` (default), `center`, `end`, `random`. One of: start, center, end, random.

ease.description: Ease applied to the delay distribution.

LoopValue.description: `loop`: a preset (name or object), or a bool for video clips.

StyleRef.description: `style`: a theme text-style name (text layers) or a box style (box layers).

BoxStyle.description: Flexbox style of a `box` (and of a box's children: `grow`).

padding.description: Number, `[v, h]` or `[t, r, b, l]`.

align.description: Cross axis: `start`, `center` (default), `end`, `stretch`. One of: start, center, end, stretch.

justify.description: Main axis: `start`, `center`, `end`, `spaceBetween`, `spaceAround`, `spaceEvenly`. One of: start, center, end, spaceBetween, spaceAround, spaceEvenly.

columns.description: Grid with this many equal columns.

Padding.description: Padding: one value, `[v, h]` or `[t, r, b, l]`.

FitValue.description:
`fit`: an image mode (`"cover"`) or, on text, `true`. Derefs to the word
(`"true"` / `"false"` for booleans) so callers match on strings.

DotsSpec.description: `dots`: many points from an array or a CSV file (`x,y[,colour]` per line).

data.description: `[[x, y], …]` or `[[x, y, "#colour"], …]` in frame pixels, or a CSV path.

color.description: Colour of dots without their own (default `$text`).

appear.description:
Per-dot scale 0..1, an expression of `i` (index), `n` (count), `t`… e.g.
`"=clamp(t * 2000 - i, 0, 1)"` to reveal dots in order. Default 1.

shape.description: `circle` (default) or `square` (faster for very many tiny dots).

DrawItem.description: One primitive of a `draw` layer: exactly one of `d`, `points`, `circle`, `rect`, `line`.

d.description: SVG path data (`"M0 0 L100 0 Q150 50 200 0 Z"`).

points.description: A polyline `[[x, y], …]` (`closed` for a polygon, `smooth` for a curve through the points).

rect.description: `[x, y, w, h]` (with `radius` for rounded corners).

fill.description: Fill colour (none by default; `points`, `circle`, `rect` and `d` can be filled).

stroke.description: Stroke colour (default `$text` when `width` is set; lines always stroke).

width.description: Stroke width in px (default 2 when stroked).

colors.description: Per-vertex stroke colours for `points` (one per point; each segment is a gradient).

ShaderBuffer.description: One buffer pass of a shader layer (`buffers.A`).

shader.description: GLSL/WGSL source or a built-in name, as for a shader layer.

src.description: Load the source from a file.

channels.description: `iChannel0..3`: `"A"`…`"D"` (buffers), `"noise"`, or `"none"`; options as for layer channels.

AudioCue.description: An audio cue: a file (`src`) or a built-in sound effect (`sfx`).

src.description: Audio file (mp3, wav, ogg, flac, aac/m4a).

sfx.description: Built-in effect: `click`, `tick`, `pop`, `whoosh`, `swoosh`, `rise`, `riser`, `drop`, `impact`, `ding`, `chime`, `typing`, `success`. One of: click, tick, pop, whoosh, swoosh, rise, riser, drop, impact, ding, chime, typing, success.

duck.description: Duck this track while voice plays: `true`, or the reduction in dB (default 12).

voice.description: This track is a voice-over (others duck under it).

Captions.description: Captions: a list of cues, or a subtitle file with styling.

highlight.description: Colour of the word being spoken (default `$accent`).

background.description: A pill behind the caption line.

highlightBox.description: A box behind the word being spoken (TikTok style).

maxWords.description: Words per caption page (default 4; 1 = one word at a time).

upcoming.description: Words not yet spoken: `dim` (default), `hidden` (build up) or `show`.

aq.description:
Adaptive quantisation strength, 0 (off, default) to 2: spends bits on flat areas
(gradients, skies) and saves them on busy texture.

crf.description: Constant quantiser 0–51 (lower = better and bigger). Default 23 (19 high, 28 draft). `render --crf` overrides.

shutter.description: Shutter angle in degrees (360 = the whole frame interval). Default 180.

Composition.description: A 2D sub-composition with its own size and clock: layers (one scene) or scenes.

size.description: Size preset or `[w, h]`. Default: the video size.

duration.description: Seconds. Default: the length of its layers' animation (`"auto"`), or the sum of its scenes.

loop.description: Loop wherever it is used (default false: hold the last frame).
